AGRICULTURE — MOCK EXAM #16
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures 14 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Cleaning Waste Dispos? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures 14 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Cleaning Waste Dispos.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures 14 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Cleaning Waste Dispos.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures 14 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Cleaning Waste Dispos.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures 14 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Cleaning Waste Dispos.

2. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. pascal (Pa)
   B. joule (J)
   C. watt (W)
   D. newton (N)

3. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Removing all vegetation
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Overgrazing continuously
   D. Burning crop residue every week

   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Water removes heat too quickly
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel

14. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   C. Movement of water only across a membrane
   D. A chemical reaction forming ash

15. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
